introduce: Lie flat on the floor, and lift your hips off the floor while keeping your back straight. \n\nHold this position as long as you can. The bridge exercise strengthens the whole abdomen, the lower back and the glutes.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Breathe naturally.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce: Stand with arms against a wall. Put your left foot on your right ankle, then lift your right heel up and down.
name: SINGLE RIGHT LEG CALF RAISES

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Pull your shoulders back.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core.
Exhale when lifting your heel, and inhale when lowering it.
To increase the difficulty, hold dumbbells to add weight.
If you feel it's too easy, stand with the ball of your foot on a stable bench.
You should feel your calf stretching.
This exercise targets your calf.

introduce: Lie on your right side with head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen put your left foot forward on the floor. Lift your right leg up and down.
name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.
name: FLUTTER KICKS

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
Make sure your back is flat against the floor.
Tighten your core.
Breathe regularly.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise targets the abs and legs.
This exercise can increase core strength and improve your endurance.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, curve your back upward and let your head come down. Repeat the exercise.

Do it slowly with each step of this exercise.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce: Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders. \n\nThen push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. Hold this position for seconds.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe slowly while holding yourself up.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your left knee forward and drop your right knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce: Sit with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your right leg with your right foot close to your left thigh.\n\nLean your upper body forward. Hold this position.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs, and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nSpread your legs, then bring them back. Repeat the exercise.
name: LEG SPREADS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your back should always be flat on the floor.
This exercises tones your inner thighs.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. 

Bring your left knee forward, place your left foot on the ground between your right hand and right knee and drop your left knee close to your left wrist on the ground. 

Slide your right leg backward. Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg, with your fingers apart and your palms facing each other. Hold for a few seconds.
name: PIGEON POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Walk slowly. Place your heel on the ground, roll fully through the foot to your toes, then push yourself forward with your toes.
name: CORRECT FOOT MOTION

tips.text: Let\'s do a simple walking.This exercise helps you to relax.
It\'s a good exercise to help improve your walking gait.
Walk slowly to feel the pressure from your heel to your outside of the foot, to your inside of the foot and then to your toes.
Breathe naturally.
